description: Crawl a site from one URL and extract its same-site pages as Markdown/text/HTML. Starts a job and waits up to wait_seconds: returns results if done, else the job id for get_crawl_status. Per successful page: normal 1cr, advanced 1cr, ultra 2cr; failed/skipped pages free. Obeys robots.txt. Max pages: Free 10, PAYG 100, Project 500, Bootstrap 2k, Startup 5k, Growth 10k. Results kept 3 days.

exclude_paths.description: Path globs to skip (* one segment, ** any depth), e.g. ["/blog/**"].

idempotency_key.description: Optional; the same key within 24h returns the original job.

ignore_query_parameters.description: Merge URLs differing only by query. Default true.

include_paths.description: Path globs to crawl (* one segment, ** any depth), e.g. ["/blog/**"].

max_content_chars.description: Clip each page's content to this many chars (default 4000).

max_depth.description: Link depth to follow (default 3; 0 = start page only).

sitemap.description: 'include' (default) also seeds from the sitemap; 'skip' links only; 'only' sitemap pages, no link following.

url.description: Start URL; pages under its path are crawled first.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish (default 30).

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL that gets a signed POST when the job ends; secret returned once as webhook_secret.

name: crawl_website
title: Crawl Website
